about:
Twisted Apparel Co. operates from Belle Fourche, South Dakota, where it was founded in 2017 as a family-owned and operated apparel shop. The company began with a focus on delivering bold style and quality through in-house customization services.

The shop provides a full suite of in-house decoration processes, including screen printing, embroidery, laser engraving, UV printing, Aqua Fusion (direct-to-film printing), sublimation, and 3D printing. All work is performed under one roof without outsourcing, covering custom apparel, promotional items, drinkware, awards, signage, and prototype parts.

Twisted Apparel serves businesses and sports teams, producing team gear, branded merchandise, corporate gifts, and custom hard goods. Customers include organizations seeking branded apparel, promotional products, and personalized items such as drinkware and awards.

The company emphasizes its differentiators: no middlemen or shortcuts, premium materials selected for durability, a personal touch on every order, and creative execution that brings client ideas to life with bold design and sharp detail.
